EPISODE & ADMISSION INFORMATION
Admission Date: 2026-01-20 | Discharge Finalized: 2026-02-10
Primary Service: Department of Surgical Oncology
Procedure Performed: Right partial mastectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy on 2026-01-20
HOSPITAL COURSE SUMMARY
The patient underwent planned surgical intervention on 2026-01-20 under general anesthesia. Post-operative recovery in PACU was
uncomplicated. Vital signs remained stable throughout hospitalization. Surgical drains were removed per protocol. Tolerated regular oral
diet and mobilized independently.
DOCUMENTED LAB REVIEW PRIOR TO DISCHARGE
Post-operative laboratory testing on 2026-02-05 recorded Hemoglobin at 12.8 g/dL with stable electrolyte panel. No evidence of surgical
site infection or systemic complications during the episode.
